description: Official post-processing reference rule for the modal metrics f2 (second-mode energy fraction) and ft (temporal fraction). Each value published in the manuscript maps to EXACTLY ONE campaign; values are never cross-substituted between campaigns.

BASELINE_REFERENCE.run: Re=500, Fourier basis, E*=0.25 (nominal), baseline network (seed 42 campaign-final)
used_in: Abstract/modal concentration paragraph (coupled with Re=100 91.6 and Re=1000 64.0)
Table tab:energy row E*=0.25 (Re=500 energy-sweep campaign)

rule: If the text refers to the BASELINE parameterization campaign (13_parametrization), the modal fraction at Re=500 is f2=92.2% (ft=1.3%), E_r=0.2534, A2=0.6835.
If the text refers to the ENERGY-SWEEP campaign (03_energy_sweep) at E*=0.25 (Re=500), the modal fraction is f2=92.5% (ft=1.2%), E_r=0.2534.
The two values differ (92.2 vs 92.5) because they come from two independent Paper-1 training campaigns, not from a rounding inconsistency. They must remain attributed to their respective campaign.
Prohibited: picking an arbitrary single value for both contexts, replacing 92.5 -> 92.2 (or conversely) inside a table without changing the campaign label.
